dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave parabolic curvature from the posterior base to the sub-apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius with a rounded morphological classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.3:1 ratio of maximal basal width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth structural convexity with a curve radius approximately equal to the vertical cranial depth.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thickened rostrum visible extending from the melon base with low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (approximately 150 degrees) at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly luminous horizontal reflection band across the mid-lateral flank and high-contrast digital masking on background.
